frequency_question: How often do announced major tariffs take effect on schedule without being cancelled or superseded by a deal before the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes any formal executive announcement of broad import tariffs with a stated future implementation date; excludes routine antidumping/countervailing duties or minor sector-specific tariffs without broad macroeconomic/geopolitical significance.
